4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I woke up to a loud knock on the door.

6.speaker: Iosef Lancea
6.text: “We need to talk, Mr. President. This is urgent.”

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I managed to open my eyes and looked at the clock. It was 11:58 PM.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Who could it be at this hour?

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Huffing and puffing, I put on my slippers.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Out of habit, I looked towards the other side of the bed. It was empty.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: I looked at the other side of the bed. Monica was sleeping soundly.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: I started walking downstairs. I heard another knock on the door, louder this time.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: Another knock. This time, even louder.

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: I could see Iosef standing outside, accompanied by a few soldiers.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: I could see General Valken Kruger outside, accompanied by a couple of soldiers.

25.speaker: Player
25.text: “What is going on? Why are you here at this hour? I won't open the door unless you answer.”

26.speaker: Valken Kruger
26.text: “We need to talk, Mr. President. This is urgent.”

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: With a scary thud, the door shook on its hinges.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: Monica rushed down the stairs, still in her nightgown. Her voice was trembling.

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: I was met with 20 to 30 men waiting near personnel trucks, all in full combat gear.

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: As I opened the door wider, they started moving towards me.

47.speaker: Player
47.text: “What the hell is the meaning of this?”

49.speaker: Player
49.text: “You can't just barge into the house of the President! I will have you removed!”

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: Another thud and the door was cracked open.

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: Soldiers immediately stormed into my house.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: No one replied. Instead, the soldiers stormed past me and into the house.

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: They entered and went through every room, checking for threats. Once they were done, they stood ready.

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: Iosef walked in. Soldiers saluted him.

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: General Kruger walked in. Soldiers saluted him.

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: Another thud and the door was cracked open.

62.speaker: Player
62.text: “You will explain to me what the hell is going on. Right now!”

63.speaker: Player
63.text: “Do you think you can just get away with this?”

67.speaker: Valken Kruger
67.text: “I'm sorry, but your time is over, Mr. President.”

68.speaker: Iosef Lancea
68.text: “I'm sorry, but your time is over, Mr. President.”

69.speaker: Iosef Lancea
69.text: “You are under arrest for your crimes against Sordland.”

70.speaker: Iosef Lancea
70.text: “Above all else, you have committed high treason and conspired against the will of your people.”

71.speaker: Valken Kruger
71.text: “Above all else, you have committed high treason and conspired against the will of your people.”

72.speaker: Valken Kruger
72.text: “You are under arrest for your crimes against Sordland.”

73.speaker: Player
73.text: “You can take me, but please, don't hurt my family.”

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “How long have you been planning this?”

75.speaker: Player
75.text: “I have done nothing wrong. Please let me go at once!”

76.speaker: Valken Kruger
76.text: “Since the day you betrayed your country.”

80.speaker: Iosef Lancea
80.text: “Since the day you betrayed your country.”

81.speaker: Valken Kruger
81.text: “I'm afraid that is impossible. We do not negotiate with traitors.”

85.speaker: Iosef Lancea
85.text: “I'm afraid that is impossible. We do not negotiate with traitors.”

86.speaker: Valken Kruger
86.text: “Rest assured. Your family will be under our watch and they will remain safe. That is, of course, if you cooperate.”
86.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Iosef_Enemy"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false)

90.speaker: Iosef Lancea
90.text: “Rest assured. Your family will be under our watch and they will remain safe. That is, of course, if you cooperate.”
90.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Iosef_Enemy"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true) == false)

91.speaker: Iosef Lancea
91.text: “The military had no choice but to take over the government to ensure the well-being of Sordland and its people.”

92.speaker: Valken Kruger
92.text: “The military had no choice but to take over the government to ensure the well-being of Sordland and its people.”

96.speaker: Iosef Lancea
96.text: “The Grand National Assembly is hereby abolished along with the immunity of members of the parliament.”

97.speaker: Iosef Lancea
97.text: “In addition, a curfew is now in effect and all gatherings are banned until further notice.”

98.speaker: Valken Kruger
98.text: “The Grand National Assembly is hereby abolished along with the immunity of members of the parliament.”

99.speaker: Valken Kruger
99.text: “In addition, a curfew is now in effect and all gatherings are banned until further notice.”

100.speaker: Iosef Lancea
100.text: “All government officials who are suspected of betraying their country will be tried in military court and made to answer for their crimes.”

101.speaker: Valken Kruger
101.text: “All government officials who are suspected of betraying their country will be tried in military court and made to answer for their crimes.”

105.speaker: Player
105.text: “No. You can't do this! I won't let you. I am the President of Sordland!”

107.speaker: Player
107.text: “You will pay one day for your heinous actions! I swear on my name!”

118.speaker: Valken Kruger
118.text: “The only heinous actions in question are yours."

119.speaker: Iosef Lancea
119.text: “The only heinous actions in question are yours."

125.speaker: Iosef Lancea
125.text: “I don't want to see his face.”

126.speaker: Valken Kruger
126.text: “I don't want to see his face.”

127.speaker: Iosef Lancea
127.text: “He will wait in a cell in Antel Rock Prison until his trial.”

128.speaker: Valken Kruger
128.text: “He will wait in a cell in Antel Rock Prison until his trial.”

132.speaker: Monica
132.text: “Anton! No! I won't let you take him!”

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: Deana appeared at the top of the stairs. She rubbed her eyes in disbelief.

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: Monica pulled on my jacket. A soldier moved in and shoved her away forcefully. Tears welled up in her eyes.

137.speaker: Player
137.text: “Everything will be fine, Monica. Take care of Deana.”

138.speaker: Player
138.text: “We will get through this. I promise.”

141.speaker: Monica
141.text: “No! You can't take him away! Please! This is unconstitutional!"

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: The soldier angrily pulled out his rifle.

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: He hit me in the head with the gunstock.

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: He escorted me to the truck. I realized I still had my slippers on.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: They roughly shoved me into the back of the vehicle, as they would a common criminal.

149.speaker: Player
149.text: “There is no need for handcuffs. I know when I have no way out.”

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: The soldier stopped in his tracks and looked at Iosef for confirmation.

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: The soldier stopped in his tracks and looked at General Kruger for confirmation.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: His men escorted me to the truck. I realized I still had my slippers on.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: They roughly shoved me into the back of the vehicle, as they would a common criminal.

161.speaker: Iosef Lancea
161.text: “You have given us an order to protect this country from threats. We are doing exactly that.”

165.speaker: Valken Kruger
165.text: “You have given us an order to protect this country from threats. We are doing exactly that.”

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: Out of habit, I looked towards the other side of the bed. It was empty. Monica and Deana were at the main house on the other side of the complex.

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Another thud, and the door was cracked open.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: Soldiers immediately stormed into the guesthouse.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: No one replied. Instead, the soldiers stormed past me and into the guesthouse.

182.speaker: Iosef Lancea
182.text: "Your wife and daughter have been taken into military custody. Rest assured, they will remain safe as long as you cooperate."

186.speaker: Valken Kruger
186.text: "Your wife and daughter have been taken into military custody. Rest assured, they will remain safe as long as you cooperate."
186.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Iosef_Enemy"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_DivorceAfterElection"] == true)

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: Suddenly, Monica came running across the courtyard, tailed closely by two military men.

197.speaker: Monica
197.text: "If they so much as lay a finger on Deana... I'll kill you myself."

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: The engine rumbled to life and the truck started moving.

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: The engine rumbled to life and the truck started moving.
